Generation-manifest and GNU/LLVM/strict audit, downstream GDB and full host/target gate remain separate; no local Windows metadata replay.

Windows filesystem metadata/transaction observations are reviewed separately; no local native-Windows replay.

No local rerun or native Windows Linux-ELF execution claimed.

Retained hosted consumer logs and transport/source hashes, thirteen positive strict reports including build-ID, actual compiler-versus-Forge boundary/caller/return arrays, and native-job completion markers. No new local runtime or Windows metadata replay.
